verdict.rationale: Factory's own docs describe AI-generated insights and suggestions on the user's code inside the product. The /review command provides "AI-powered insights" on code changes, Droid analyzes the codebase and proposes changes before applying them, and /readiness-report evaluates a repository and pairs with /readiness-fix to address failing criteria. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, and no evidence of AI insights over non-code data such as the usage metrics and delivery dashboards.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The `/review` command provides a local workflow for analyzing code changes with AI-powered insights.
Droid analyzes your codebase, proposes changes, and shows what will be modified before applying anything.
Run the /readiness-report slash command in a Factory App web or desktop session, or in the Droid CLI, to evaluate a repository's readiness level
Droid analyzes pull requests and merge requests, identifies issues, and posts feedback as inline comments.
